speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To help me understand your condition better, how many weeks pregnant are you and when did these symptoms first start?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection)

The specific detail about eating ice cream three days before symptom onset strongly suggests listeriosis, a serious infection in pregnancy that can cause these exact flu-like symptoms. We need to confirm this immediately. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture, Listeria_serology. REQUEST IMAGES: None at this time.
